newsitem.title: USA: Steelworkers ratify contract with Bucyrus.
newsitem.headline: Steelworkers ratify contract with Bucyrus.

text.p: Bucyrus International Inc said Wednesday the United Steelworkers of America Local 1343 ratified a four-year agreement with the company after rejecting a proposal three weeks earlier.
The new labor contract will continue through April 30, 2001, the company said.
Bucyrus said the company and the union agreed to negotiate after Bucyrus in April said it signed a letter of intent to buy Marion Power Shovel Co from Global Industrial Technologies Inc.

"The employees showed their cooperation and support of the company by ratifying this agreement," W.R. Hildebrand, president and chief executive of Bucyrus, said in a statement. "I am pleased with the ultimate outcome of this process."
